svg.title: Discounted NPV per share versus terminal sale price

cc:Work.dc:title: Discounted NPV per share versus terminal sale price
cc:Work.dc:description: At an initial price of 100 USD/share, a continuous annual benchmark rate of 5%, and a one-year holding period, selling at 100 USD/share gives an NPV of -4.88 USD/share. The break-even sale price is 105.13 USD/share.
